grouping.evidence_kind: statistical grouping hypothesis; not RF configuration

verification.method: manual CellMapper viewing, no bulk scraping
verification.reason: Browser access host unavailable; native UI URL safety check stopped access; web reader cannot access interactive map.
required: LTE bands / EARFCNs shown and observation date
cautions: No tower observation is not evidence of tower absence.
A nearby public tower does not by itself map anonymized CELL IDs to EARFCNs.
Current crowdsourced data may differ from 2025 KPI and 2026 Experia periods.
Unobserved carriers may be modeled only as clearly labeled TA-informed assumptions, not as verified bands.

user_observation.source: User manually opened all three coordinate views; provider screenshot confirms Turkcell LTE, all bands
user_observation.interpretation: No visible CellMapper record, not proof of physical tower absence
user_observation.advisor_fallback: Search approximately 300m around targets; if insufficient, inspect well-measured main roads/highways for regional band and sector patterns. Do not match distant towers to targets.

predeclared_experiment.baseline: S0 of experiment 14, original 2–6 km placement (TA placement remains unresolved)
predeclared_experiment.question: Does applying all strong-confidence advisor groups in the 24-site region improve representation relative to S0?
predeclared_experiment.other_sites: Remaining 20 sites: one 1800 MHz B3 carrier and 3 sectors
predeclared_experiment.measurement_positions: Reuse frozen S0 inputs; 256 measurement users, draws 701/702/703
predeclared_experiment.orientations: Reuse rotations 42/7/99. Three- and four-sector blocks retain their specified counts; orientation arrangement is an assumption, not inferred from anonymized ID order.
predeclared_experiment.load: Keep load inputs on 20 unchanged sites; explicitly freeze per-cell load generation on all four changed sites and check achieved PRB before acceptance.
predeclared_experiment.no_retuning: No RF parameter selection from 440 RSRP/SINR; 440 remains held out for tuning. Topology evidence is an input.
predeclared_experiment.gate: Before any run, freeze explicit verified or clearly labeled assumed carrier frequencies, bandwidths, powers, sector mapping, per-UE carrier selection and added-carrier load in a run plan. Do not present TA-derived band labels as verified.
metrics: Per-site RSRP/SINR signed errors and MAE by existing split
Per-carrier cell counts and serving-user shares
All measurement users connected and receiving downlink
Achieved PRB and total offered traffic
No RSRQ-based tuning; explain mixed-SINR sampling limitation
predeclared_experiment.regression: If code changes are required, compare a local disabled-feature repeat to frozen S0 outputs; normalize CRLF/LF only, no numeric tolerance.

runtime_amendments.reason: Normalize new load rates by carrier RB count: B20 50 RB gets half the packet rate of 100 RB carriers. Fixed before any run, no target-fitting.

runtime.band_mapping_status: TA-informed assumptions; not verified at project sites. B1 historical in regional example.
runtime.frequency_choice: Largest block median TA -> B20; middle -> B3; smallest -> B1. B3 remains S0 center frequency for controlled comparison; B20/B1 centers from regional example.
runtime.orientation_assumption: Same frozen site rotation; 3-sector blocks 120-degree spacing, 4-sector blocks 90-degree spacing. Beamwidth 120 degrees on both.
runtime.carrier_allocation: Strongest S0 analytical B3 cell determines provisional site. For UEs provisionally at a strong site, balanced round-robin B3/B20/B1 by UE ID; others B3. Real band shares unknown; no inter-frequency automatic selection/CA/handover claimed.
runtime.load_rule: All original 72 B3 load users copied unchanged; 27 new B20/B1 load users, 800m on boresight, target PRB .233. Interval (1.47/.233)*(100/RB) ms: double interval for B20 50 RB, unchanged for B1 100 RB. Frozen bandwidth normalization, no outcome-based calibration.
runtime.interpretation: Per-resource offered load held nominally constant, NOT constant total offered traffic/power/capacity. Equivalent traffic rises (72+14*.5+13)/72=1.27778; total cell count/power rises 99/72=1.375. Report achieved PRB separately.

technical_fixes.validation: Add direct antenna attribute tests for rotations over 90 degrees; rerun full S0 regression and all three cases under the corrected source.
